digest.component_or_area: Jira Cloud summary write and recovery
propositions: One Cloud summary write invocation must launch exactly one ACLI subprocess process with proper POSIX process-group and non-POSIX child cleanup.
Summary recovery observation performs one REST request to primary store with one-attempt/no-sleep policy, never using JQL or inner retry sleep.
Per-call retry policy parameter must thread from _rest_urlopen_with_retry through _direct_rest_get to get_issue_by_rest, defaulting to three attempts with 2s/5s backoff for all existing callers.

All unrelated REST callers (get_issue_property, search_user_by_email, transitions read, issuelinks read, and external consumers outbound_differ.py:132, apply_handlers.py:259, binding_store.py:108) must retain unchanged three-attempt/2s-5s retry behavior by omitting the new policy argument.

Permanent failures (auth, TLS, permission, invalid requests) must classify as non-retryable and return metadata to shared budget; transient failures (network, 429, retryable 5xx) must be classified correctly.

Every terminal or exhausted outcome must emit exactly one completion log containing only logical id, disposition, invocation count, request count, cleanup status, retry_not_before, and one redacted message capped at 512 Unicode code points, with whole log not exceeding 1,024 code points and at most eight bounded operation-diagnostics entries.
